evidence.finding: Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.Mono.android-arm64 10.0.12 THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.TXT section 'License notice for zlib-ng' (LF sha256 aeacdb4777e6e3c664c1d0d8d0e9cf3676a633a0d9e3747498a2bae0680ae483); the section cites zlib-ng LICENSE.md at d54e3769 and the Zlib terms.

licence.scope: Verbatim zlib-ng section (Zlib licence) of the Mono runtime bundle; admitted for the MAUI shipped closure. This record does not admit any implementation.
licence.copyingPermission: Verbatim reproduction of the governing legal document and required notices for licensed distribution; no modification of its operative terms and no implication of trademark endorsement.

attribution: Copyright notices and licence terms as printed in the upstream legal document; see the retained section.

verification.command: Split the pinned legal document at its section headers; compare the LF-normalized section bytes with the target SHA-256 and the target file name.
verification.expected: The retained section is verbatim, after LF normalization, from the pinned legal document.

notice.text: Retain this legal text verbatim with the MAUI Android release notices.
notice.reason: The MAUI Android release notices must carry the zlib-ng notice of the Mono runtime bundle (AND.40 unit 5b; decision 20).

review.rationale: Zlib terms, admitted as a permissive OSI licence for the MAUI shipped closure; the notice ships in every .NET Android application and is compatible with Apache-2.0 distribution (AND.40 unit 5b, decision 20).
